coastal.title: Suspicious fires in abandoned Sechelt neighbourhood put residents on edge
coastal.description: The fires were reported in the Seawatch neighbourhood around 10 a.m. Saturday, but firefighters were forced to watch as the homes burned for hours, as the area is off-limits.

coastal.title: 2 homes in abandoned Sechelt neighbourhood destroyed by arson, fire department says
coastal.description: Two of 14 abandoned homes in Sechelt's Seawatch subdivision, which has been fenced off since 2019 due to sinkholes, have burned down.
